title: A-S 344 - Introduction to Sonic Art: Sound as Material
description: This class includes both theoretical background and practical experience in understanding, capturing, creating, and editing sound as material for contemporary art. Topics include the properties of sound, the anatomy of hearing, deep listening, field recording, audio sampling, sound synthesis, audio editing, sound manipulation, and sound mixing. Applications of the skills learned include music, sound art, sound installation, foley/effects for video, filmmaking and animation, user interface sound design, and narrative sound for radio or podcasts.
